additional_info.body:
Hi Milan, good afternoon. I hope you had a nice weekend.
I finally had the time to look at it.
I can see that sometimes before the charging starts I see the Power setpoint to 0.
Example where it worked a few hours before:
This definitely looks like the implementation is incorrect at some times.
To be honest, after you did the changes I have not noticed any more of these occurrences.
I would convey this information to the backend to check with them if there is something kind of logic that is incorrect.
I will close the ticket since it has been resolved. If you need my support just ping me in Teams.
THank you and have a nice start of the week.
Francisco
